03   /   THE SHELTER 
A place to pause. 
Not a destination. A way of being. 
A small shelter, a generous window, the sound of rain.
Enough space to put the day down and pick up a book.
The best rooms leave some room for the world outside. 
Fig. 03   /   A imagined forest cabin. Original architectural illustration.
